title: The next thing to come as the headline, and the ones after it as dated cards
about: Classes, matches, shows, meetings, departures, open days: rows with a day, of which visitors come for the next one. It leads with that one (a date block, its title, when and where, how long until it, its main action) and lists the ones after it as cards with their day. Put it first on a page whose visitors come for what is next, never below a slogan.

date.about: the column with each row's day ('YYYY-MM-DD') or time

time.about: a column with its time of day, when date has none

place.about: a column with where it is

text.about: a column with a short text

badge.about: a column with a short word shown beside its title (Full, New)

where.about: an SQL condition on the rows (one condition; wrap ORs in parentheses)

eyebrow.about: the line above the next one's title

action.about: the main button's words (Enter, Book a place)

open.about: the view the action opens with {id}

call.about: the function the action calls with {id}

title.about: a heading over the ones after it

more.about: how many after it are shown
